title.narrative: SAT Strategic and Business Plan: Making the money work for communities in Southern Africa though increased HIV/AIDS competence 2009-13
SAT Strategic and Business Plan: Making the money work for communities in Southern Africa though increased HIV/AIDS competence 2009-13

description.narrative: SAT is supporting org. capacity building at regional & national level to respond to the HIV/AIDS epidemic. The purpose for SAT's 08-2013 strategic period is to increase community HIV & AIDS competence in Southern Africa for communities to improve evidence based prevention efforts, improve access and adherence to treatment, provide adequate care and support and to mitigate the impact of the epidemic.
